heading: INT. ROLLER RINK - TEMPORARY COURTROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. ROLLER RINK - TEMPORARY COURTROOM - DAY
The county courthouse flooded in March.
Now a folding table stands on the maple skating floor, and a disco ball hangs dead above it.
Rental skates hang on a wall rack behind the bench.
NADIA BRZEZINSKI, 40s, public defender, sorts papers into two stacks.
Her suit is good but the shoes are sneakers.
She looks at the door twice.
A YOUNG MAN in a borrowed suit sits across from her.
The sleeves cover his knuckles.
He is picking at the cuff.
They said it'd be at the courthouse.
units.name: YOUNG MAN

units.text: It's under four feet of water.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Right.
units.name: YOUNG MAN

units.text: He nods.
He keeps nodding a moment too long.
You didn't wear the tie I told you to.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: It's in the car.
units.name: YOUNG MAN

units.text: Is the car here?
units.name: NADIA

units.text: He looks at the exit sign.
She watches him look.
What's your name? Say it for me. The way you'll say it to her.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Tobias Wren.
units.name: YOUNG MAN

units.text: Again. Slower.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Tobias Wren.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: She slides a pen across the table.
He doesn't take it.
She leaves it there.
The state's offer expires at ten. It's nine fifty.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: My mom said I shouldn't sign anything.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Your mom isn't here.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: She's in the lot.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Nadia stops sorting.
She puts both hands flat on the table.
Go get her.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Tobias stands.
Sits back down.
Stands again.
Walks halfway to the door and turns around.
I'll sign it.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Don't do it because I said "go get her."
units.name: NADIA

units.text: He picks up the pen.
His hand is steady now, steadier than hers.
The side door bangs open.
JUDGE FAUSTINA OYELOWO-MARSH, 60s, robe over a cardigan, enters on rental skates and rolls to a stop at the bench.
Nobody laughs.
Counsel. Mr. Wren. We are on the record.
units.name: JUDGE OYELOWO-MARSH

units.text: Tobias holds the pen above the page.
Nadia takes it out of his fingers, gently, and caps it.
Your Honor, we need ten more minutes.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: You have two.
units.name: JUDGE OYELOWO-MARSH

units.text: Nadia nods.
Tobias, very quietly, starts to untie his shoes.
